title: Finding Evidence Brief UX Foundation
goal: Make the existing Finding Theater evidence and methodology data feel like an operator-grade intelligence brief without changing finding schema fields.
scope: Improve the presentation of existing finding risk, methodology, exploitability, verification, methodology lineage, and related execution excerpts using additive UI components such as brief-style cards and terminal-style evidence blocks. Reuse existing Finding Theater data and evidence replay structures. Do not add new canonical finding fields.
generation_reason: Backlog refresh requested by the project owner after the previous queue ended at backlog item 10.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to presentation of existing finding/evidence data. Do not change finding schema, scoring semantics, or report generation.
notes: Render existing data more clearly before adding new data.
Evidence excerpts must stay grounded in stored artifacts and task output.

success_criteria: Finding Theater shows risk, methodology, exploitability, and evidence-readiness in clearer structured UI.
Related execution excerpts are easier to inspect in a terminal-style evidence display without leaving the evidence-first model.
Existing findings without enriched or optional fields still render truthfully.
Browser coverage proves the new presentation for populated and sparse findings.
No canonical finding schema fields are added, removed, or redefined.

acceptance_criteria: The UI improvement is backed by existing Finding Theater data.
Sparse findings degrade gracefully without fake state.
No finding schema or methodology contract changes are introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
No report or finding-schema rewrite is bundled into this task.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with UI changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the new analysis UX baseline and limitations.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.

out_of_scope: Evidence fabrication or synthetic terminal output
